summary: Federal Communications Commission should preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program and reject any proposal to eliminate, sunset, or restrict E-Rate support for schools and libraries. School districts and school staff emphasize the essential role of E-Rate in providing reliable, high-quality broadband infrastructure for modern public education. The proposal to eliminate or sunset E-Rate would have a direct and tangible impact on school budgets, forcing districts to divert resources from other es The school district urges the FCC to preserve and improve the E-Rate program rather than sunset or eliminate it, emphasizing its role in providing reliable broadband for students and libraries.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program
claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
